name: Mahesh Basavaraj
title: Assistant Professor · AI Researcher · Former Enterprise Engineer
tagline: Bridging production-grade software engineering and frontier AI research — from banking platforms at Infosys and Accenture to Agentic AI in the classroom.
summary: Computer Science educator, AI researcher and former enterprise systems engineer with 8 years building banking and capital-markets software at Infosys and Accenture, and 8 years teaching and researching in engineering academia. Assistant Professor in CSE (Data Science) at DSATM and doctoral researcher under VTU. Holder of 3 utility patents and author of 10+ publications spanning Agentic AI, Large Language Models, spatio-temporal deep learning and cognitive IoT networks. Known for turning research into working systems and for building industry-partnered AI programmes for students and faculty.

academic.org: Dayananda Sagar Academy of Technology & Management (DSATM)
points: Teach and run labs in Data Science, Deep Learning and Agentic AI within an autonomous, VTU-affiliated framework.
Built and led a flagship 6-month Agentic AI immersion programme for students in partnership with Capabl, alongside institutional Faculty Development Programmes.
Supervise final-year capstone projects and drive departmental research, including utility patents in machine-assisted automation and IoT systems.
Taught core computing courses and supervised applied machine-learning student projects.
Coordinated departmental technical workshops and student mentoring.
Taught object-oriented programming, data structures and web/cloud architectures.
Published research evaluating OpenAI Codex on real-world coding and deep-learning credit-card fraud detection.

academic.org: Navya PU College & Janaseva PU College
points: Taught pre-university programming, algorithms and computational logic.
Developed scalable enterprise modules in Java/J2EE and Spring with relational databases for international capital-markets clients.
Worked across global agile teams through the full SDLC — JIRA-driven triage, automated builds and release integration.

industry.role: Senior Systems Engineer · Systems Engineer — Finacle
points: Built and enhanced Finacle CRM and the Finacle universal banking platform used by banks worldwide.
Refactored backend services, tuned SQL and transaction-processing paths, and owned system-integration testing and deployments.
